Senate Committee on Foreign Relations
committees.jurisdiction: The Senate Committee on Foreign Relations was established in 1816 as one of the original ten standing committees of the Senate. The committee has considered, debated, and reported important treaties and legislation, ranging from the purchase of Alaska in 1867 to the establishment of the United Nations in 1945. It also holds jurisdiction over all diplomatic nominations.
